Pull requests are accepted only under the rules in CONTRIBUTING.md. A pull request that
does not meet them is closed.

## Issue

Link to the issue in which the maintainer agreed to this change:

## What this changes, and why

## Checklist

- [ ] The maintainer agreed to this change in the linked issue.
- [ ] I agreed to the contributor agreement (CLA.md), here or in an earlier pull request.
- [ ] One change only.
- [ ] It does not make the apps or the server collect, send, store or show more than
      before. If it does, the issue says so clearly.
- [ ] Android and iOS behave the same after this change, or I noted what is missing.
- [ ] The tests from the README pass, and I added or updated tests for what I changed.
- [ ] No secrets, config files, real project ids or contact details.
- [ ] Texts for users exist in English and German and contain no hyphen or dash except
      S-Bahn and U-Bahn.
- [ ] Everything here is my own work.
